# Array — inspiration only

HVAC, engineering, and agency dashboards. Motion personality: precise technical. Scan line, grid draw, terminal steps, a number stream. No bounce, no blob, no camera.

## Look at

- Codrops terminal-typography experiments linked from the scroll-text index. Glyphs that resolve, not a fade. https://tympanus.net/Development/ScrollTextMotion/
- Mobbin’s public pattern pages for dashboards: dense type, status as a word plus a mark, keyboard command surfaces. We do not copy a Raycast red bar.
- Line25, 2026. Scroll-driven motion on transform and opacity, state changes that acknowledge the user. https://line25.com/articles/web-design-trends-2026/
- 21st.dev and Origin UI, August 2026. Product controls that stay plain. Array is the opposite of plain chrome, but the controls must stay operable. https://21st.dev/blog/magic-ui-alternatives

## We will write

Graphite, ice blue, amber data. A rule draws with `scaleX`. A scan bar travels with `translateY`. Headlines step in character by character. Buttons do not scale.

## We will not write

A manila job ticket, a green-on-black movie terminal, or a shared hover lift.
